#!/usr/bin/python3
"""Use upstream Git URLs and fail closed before cloning a local partial repository."""

import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

arguments = sys.argv[1:]
package = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
if "clone" in arguments:
    evidence = package.parent / "verification/local-ai-step1/resume/mlx-clone-commands.jsonl"
    evidence.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with evidence.open("a") as log:
        log.write(json.dumps(arguments) + "\n")
    for argument in arguments:
        source = Path(argument)
        if source.is_dir() and ((source / "config").is_file() or (source / ".git/config").is_file()):
            config = source / "config" if (source / "config").is_file() else source / ".git/config"
            content = config.read_text().lower()
            if "promisor" in content or "partialclone" in content:
                raise SystemExit("Cloning a local partial repository is disabled after a verified recursive-fetch failure.")
os.environ["GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH"] = "1"
os.execv("/usr/bin/git", [
    "/usr/bin/git", "--no-lazy-fetch", "-c", "http.version=HTTP/1.1",
    "-c", "fetch.recurseSubmodules=false", *arguments,
])

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare pinned source snapshots for explicit local integration checks only."""

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

package = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
repositories = package / ".build/repositories"
evidence = package.parent / "verification/local-ai-step1/resume"
specifications = [
    ("swift-numerics", "swift-numerics-d936ec6c", "apple/swift-numerics", "1.1.1", ["Sources"]),
    ("swift-jinja", "swift-jinja-c9e03d9c", "huggingface/swift-jinja", "3.1.0", ["Sources"]),
    ("EventSource", "EventSource-24732f58", "mattt/EventSource", "1.6.0", ["Sources"]),
    ("yyjson", "yyjson-04ab5379", "ibireme/yyjson", "0.12.0", ["src", "include"]),
    ("swift-huggingface", "swift-huggingface-ffa527b1", "huggingface/swift-huggingface", "1.0.0", ["Sources"]),
    ("swift-collections", "swift-collections-9a58d5cf", "apple/swift-collections", "1.7.6", ["Sources"]),
    ("swift-syntax", "swift-syntax-e1f983d3", "swiftlang/swift-syntax", "603.0.2", ["Sources"]),
]
for identity, cache, repository, revision, roots in specifications:
    with (evidence / ("mlx-hydrate-" + identity + ".log")).open("w") as log:
        subprocess.run([
            sys.executable, str(package / "Tools/hydrate-reviewed-snapshot.py"),
            "--cache", str(repositories / cache), "--repository", repository,
            "--revision", revision, "--identity", identity, "--roots", *roots,
            "--workers", "2",
        ], check=True, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Create an explicit temporary source-check package. Leave the canonical manifest unchanged."""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument("--common-crypto", action="store_true", help="Use the supported Crypto3.15.1 snapshot shared with Wax.")
arguments = parser.parse_args()
package = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
snapshots = Path.home() / "Library/Caches/MemoryOS-AI-Evaluation/mlx-verified-snapshots"
asn1 = Path.home() / "Library/Caches/MemoryOS-AI-Evaluation/wax-verified-snapshots/swift-asn1"
evidence = package.parent / "verification/local-ai-step1/resume"
check_package = package / (".build/local-sdk-checks-common" if arguments.common_crypto else ".build/local-sdk-checks")
common_crypto = Path.home() / "Library/Caches/MemoryOS-AI-Evaluation/wax-verified-snapshots/swift-crypto"
identities = [
    "mlx-swift-lm", "mlx-swift", "swift-transformers", "swift-numerics", "swift-jinja",
    "EventSource", "yyjson", "swift-huggingface", "swift-collections", "swift-syntax", "swift-crypto",
]
missing = [identity for identity in identities if not (evidence / ("mlx-snapshot-" + identity + ".json")).exists()]
if missing:
    raise SystemExit("Wait for verified snapshot hydration: " + ", ".join(missing))
if not (asn1 / "Package.swift").is_file():
    raise SystemExit("The read-only matching ASN1 source snapshot is unavailable.")
check_package.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for directory in ["Sources", "Tests"]:
    link = check_package / directory
    target = package / directory
    if link.is_symlink():
        if link.resolve() != target:
            raise SystemExit("Unexpected integration source link; preserved it.")
    elif link.exists():
        raise SystemExit("Unexpected integration source directory; preserved it.")
    else:
        link.symlink_to(target, target_is_directory=True)

def swift_path(path):
    return json.dumps(str(path))

dependencies = [".package(path: " + swift_path(package.parent / "LocalAIEvaluation") + ")"]
for identity in identities:
    traits = ", traits: []" if identity == "mlx-swift-lm" else ""
    dependency_path = common_crypto if identity == "swift-crypto" and arguments.common_crypto else snapshots / identity
    if not (dependency_path / "Package.swift").is_file():
        raise SystemExit("A required reviewed dependency manifest is unavailable: " + identity)
    dependencies.append(".package(path: " + swift_path(dependency_path) + traits + ")")
dependencies.append(".package(path: " + swift_path(asn1) + ")")
manifest = '''// swift-tools-version: 6.2
// TEMPORARY LOCAL SNAPSHOT CHECK. This does not replace the canonical direct-URL manifest.
import PackageDescription
let package = Package(
  name: "MLXLocalSourceChecks",
  platforms: [.iOS(.v18), .macOS(.v14)],
  products: [
    .library(name: "MLXEvaluationAdapter", targets: ["MLXEvaluationAdapter"]),
    .executable(name: "mlx-evaluation", targets: ["MLXEvaluationCLI"]),
  ],
  dependencies: [
    DEPENDENCIES
  ],
  targets: [
    .target(name: "MLXEvaluationAdapter", dependencies: [
      .product(name: "AIEvaluationCore", package: "LocalAIEvaluation"),
      .product(name: "MLXLLM", package: "mlx-swift-lm"),
      .product(name: "MLXLMCommon", package: "mlx-swift-lm"),
      .product(name: "Tokenizers", package: "swift-transformers"),
    ]),
    .executableTarget(name: "MLXEvaluationCLI", dependencies: [
      "MLXEvaluationAdapter", .product(name: "AIEvaluationCore", package: "LocalAIEvaluation")
    ]),
    .testTarget(name: "MLXEvaluationAdapterTests", dependencies: [
      "MLXEvaluationAdapter", .product(name: "AIEvaluationCore", package: "LocalAIEvaluation")
    ]),
  ], swiftLanguageModes: [.v6]
)
'''.replace("DEPENDENCIES", ",\n    ".join(dependencies) + ",")
(check_package / "Package.swift").write_text(manifest)
receipt = {
    "temporaryIntegrationOnly": True,
    "canonicalResolutionVerified": False,
    "canonicalManifestSHA256": hashlib.sha256((package / "Package.swift").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    "checkPackage": str(check_package),
    "snapshotRoots": {identity: str(common_crypto if identity == "swift-crypto" and arguments.common_crypto else snapshots / identity) for identity in identities},
    "sharedCryptoRevision": "95ba0316a9b733e92bb6b071255ff46263bbe7dc" if arguments.common_crypto else None,
    "sharedCryptoPermittedRanges": ["Tokenizers3.0.0..<5.0.0", "HuggingFace1.0.0..<5.0.0"] if arguments.common_crypto else [],
    "readOnlySharedASN1Snapshot": str(asn1),
    "sharedASN1Revision": "917b472dbe53ba699cbb0495f9a95a084bc6364d",
}
(evidence / ("mlx-local-check-package-common.json" if arguments.common_crypto else "mlx-local-check-package.json")).write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
(evidence / ("mlx-local-check-manifest-common.swift" if arguments.common_crypto else "mlx-local-check-manifest.swift")).write_text(manifest)
print(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2))
